## Company Overview
- SKEQI (思客琦) is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment. (**Verified**): [1], [3]
- The company was established in 2012. (**Verified**): [3], [5], [6]
- Its headquarters and primary operational base are located in Ningde City, Fujian Province, at No. 115 Shugang Road, Jiaocheng District. (**Verified**): [1]
- The company operates four major industrial manufacturing bases across Ningde Jiaocheng, Ningde Dongqiao, Shanghai Songjiang, and Dalian Beihai. (**Verified**): [3], [5]
- Current employee scale is approximately 2,000 people. (**Verified**): [3], [5]

## Main Products & Services
- **New Energy Intelligent Equipment:** Provides complete turnkey production lines for cell assembly, module formation, PACK encapsulation, and battery recycling/disassembly. (**Verified**): [1], [3], [5]
- **Digital Factory Systems:** Offers the proprietary QIHANG 5G Digital Factory System, integrating pack line workstations, boundary warehouses, WMS, MES, and supply chain management with big-data visualization dashboards. (**Verified**): [1]
- **Intelligent Logistics:** Deploys the "Ke Pai Le" brand to deliver smart conveying, material handling, warehousing, and non-standard automation systems. (**Verified**): [1]
- **Laser Application Technology:** Delivers one-stop laser solutions for industrial manufacturing, focusing on laser welding, laser energy control, and laser beam shaping technologies. (**Verified**): [1]
- **Industrial Non-Destructive Testing (NDT):** Manufactures and deploys high-end 2D/3D X-ray smart inspection equipment and solutions. (**Verified**): [1]
- **Precision Intelligent Manufacturing:** Handles the R&D, design, development, and production of industrial equipment components, molds, precision plastics, hardware accessories, and battery/electrical parts. (**Verified**): [1]
- **Automotive & Components:** Supplies flexible, automated, and intelligent production lines for automotive body panels, chassis components, and white-body welding operations. (**Verified**): [1]

## Industries / Markets Served
- New energy lithium-ion battery manufacturing. (**Verified**): [1], [3], [5]
- Automobile and auto parts manufacturing. (**Verified**): [1], [3], [5]
- Photovoltaic and energy storage industries. (**Verified**): [3], [5]
- 3C electronics and semiconductor sectors. (**Verified**): [1]
- Aerospace industry. (**Verified**): [1]
- General industrial engineering manufacturing. (**Verified**): [1]

## Customer Segments
- Leading lithium battery cell and power/storage system manufacturers. (**Verified**): [1], [3], [5]
- New energy vehicle (NEV) original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). (**Verified**): [1], [3], [5]
- Photovoltaic and energy storage enterprise clients. (**Verified**): [3], [5]
- Special vehicle operators and industrial logistics companies. (**Verified**): [1]

## Key Customers / Partners
- **Battery & Energy Storage Manufacturers:** CATL (宁德时代), CALB (中创新航), EVE Energy (亿纬锂能), Gotion High-tech (国轩高科), Ronbay Energy (瑞浦能源), and Hithium (海辰). (**Verified**): [1], [3], [5] (First-party source: [1]; Third-party sources: [3], [5])
- **Automotive OEMs:** XPeng (小鹏), Leapmotor (零跑), Audi, BMW, Ford, Geely, and SAIC. (**Verified**): [1], [3], [5] (First-party source: [1]; Third-party sources: [3], [5])
- **Special Vehicle Enterprises:** Linde (林德) and Hangcha (杭叉). (**Verified**): [1] (First-party source)
- No formal strategic technology, distribution, or joint-venture partners are documented in the provided evidence. (**Not enough evidence**)

## Competitive / Strategic Positioning
- Held the #1 domestic market share for module and PACK production lines in 2023. (**Verified**): [3], [5]
- Commercial operations have expanded into European, Southeast Asian, and North American markets. (**Verified**): [3], [5]
- Maintains recognized competitive advantages in technical maturity, cost control, and delivery assurance for high-volume client deployments. (**Verified**): [1]
- Corporate R&D is centralized under the SKEQI Intelligent Manufacturing Advanced Technology Research Institute (IMATI), which prioritizes the integration of NDT, motion control, AI, 5G, robotics, and vision systems. (**Verified**): [1]

## Differentiators
- End-to-end manufacturing capability spanning the entire battery lifecycle from cell assembly to PACK assembly and end-of-life recycling. (**Verified**): [1], [3]
- Fully integrated proprietary digital factory software (QIHANG MES/WMS) coupled with 5G connectivity for real-time production visualization and traceability. (**Verified**): [1]
- In-house development strategy targeting core bottleneck technologies, specifically laser applications and industrial X-ray NDT, with goals to shorten core component lead times and enhance custom fabrication capabilities. (**Verified**): [1]
- Recipient of multiple national and provincial recognitions, including National Specialized "Little Giant" Enterprise, National Service-Oriented Manufacturing Demonstration Enterprise, Fujian Manufacturing Single Champion, and the CATL "Best Equipment Quality Response Award". (**Verified**): [1], [3], [5]
- Continuous hardware innovation demonstrated by recent patent grants, such as CN224662069U for a taped cell pre-stacking secondary positioning slide table that minimizes displacement during stacking. (**Verified**): [2]

## Brand / Company Values
- Core corporate values are explicitly defined as Integrity (诚信), Innovation (创新), Responsibility (责任), and Gratitude (感恩). (**Verified**): [1]
- Strategic brand philosophy emphasizes forward-looking capacity layout, leveraging technological breakthroughs to drive energy industry transformation, and building a collaborative smart manufacturing ecosystem. (**Verified**): [1]

## Recent Relevant Developments
- December 9: Delivered a keynote presentation titled "Energy Storage Manufacturing Energy Efficiency Improvement Path" at the GGII Energy Storage Annual Conference. (**Verified**): [1]
- November 20: Received the GGII Lithium Battery 15th Anniversary Special Award for "15 Years of Technology Leap". (**Verified**): [1]
- August 2025: Granted utility model patent CN224662069U for a taped cell pre-stacking secondary positioning slide table, improving stacking placement precision. (**Verified**): [2]
- Late 2025 to 2026: Conducted active nationwide campus recruitment drives (including Fuzhou University, Dalian Polytechnic University, and Dalian University of Technology) and expanded hiring pipelines for mechanical, electrical, algorithm, and management trainee roles. (**Verified**): [3], [5], [6]

## Research Confidence / Gaps
- **Confidence:** High confidence regarding product portfolio, core technologies, stated corporate values, location details, and named customer bases. Claims are consistently corroborated across the official website and independent university/job board postings.
- **Gaps:** 
  - Precise annual revenue, profit margins, or order backlog figures are completely absent from the evidence.
  - The official website contains dynamic placeholder artifacts (e.g., "年+", "项+", "TOP") due to script-based rendering, preventing verification of exact project counts, years of operation metrics, or market share percentages.
  - Detailed information on formal strategic partners, distributors, or academic research consortia is not provided.
  - Executive leadership structure beyond the legal representative (Fu Wenhui) is unavailable.
  - Corporate structural nuances between the Ningde-operating entities and the Shanghai-registered corporation (上海思客琦智能装备科技股份有限公司) require direct filings to fully map ownership and operational hierarchies.
